stages.title: CONTEMPORARY TECHNOLOGY ANCHOR — SEMANTIC FIDELITY IN SACRED-TEXT TRANSLATION [SUPPORTING]
stages.terms: ⚠️ Inference: This contemporary translation problem illustrates a core philosophical point: religious meaning is not exhausted by word substitution.
stages.mechanism: ⚠️ Inference: This contemporary translation problem illustrates a core philosophical point: religious meaning is not exhausted by word substitution.
stages.consequence: Context, use, symbolic reference and a tradition’s conceptual grammar affect what an utterance means, though an AI translation benchmark does not settle whether the original claims are truth-apt.
stages.trap: ⚠️ Inference: This contemporary translation problem illustrates a core philosophical point: religious meaning is not exhausted by word substitution.
stages.answer: ✅ Fact: An ICML 2026 paper on Sanskrit–English translation reports that purely statistical generation can cause semantic drift in culturally embedded and ritual concepts, and proposes dictionary, morpho-syntactic and glossary-grounded decoding to preserve sacred entities and terminology.

stages.title: VISUAL GATEWAY — NEVER MERGE THE TWO AXES
stages.terms: Visual gateway — never merge the two axes: 🔑 Mnemonic — two axes: "HOW (Analogy/Symbol/Negation) × WHETHER (Cognitive/Non-cognitive)." Analogy & symbol rescue meaning; the cog/non-cog debate is about factual truth.
stages.mechanism: Master verdict: Religious utterances are often assertoric, symbolic and performative together; a mixed account preserves realist intent while acknowledging that transcendence requires non-literal modes of predication.
stages.consequence: A symbol (unlike a mere sign) participates in the reality it points to and "opens up levels of reality otherwise closed".
stages.trap: So "good" applies proportionally, truly but not identically. → preserves meaning without anthropomorphism.
stages.answer: Analogy preserves ordered similarity, symbol mediates participation and negation removes creaturely limitation; each seeks meaningful reference without literal anthropomorphism.
